item.title: Student Recital - Jaxon Roberts — Nov 14, 2026
item.description:
Strauss Performing Arts Center Saturday, November 14, 2026 · 4:00 PM On Saturday, November 14, at 4:00 p.m., Jaxon Roberts will present his senior vocal recital at the Strauss Performing Arts Center on the University of Nebraska at Omaha campus. The recital will explore the cycles of love and the many forms in which love is experienced throughout our lives. Through a diverse selection of vocal repertoire, Roberts will take audiences on a musical journey highlighting the beauty, complexity, joy, and heartbreak of love.
Jaxon Roberts is a vocal music education major at the University of Nebraska at Omaha, where he is pursuing his Bachelor of Music in Music Education with an emphasis in PK–12 education. Throughout his musical career, Roberts has developed a passion for vocal performance, music education, and creating meaningful musical experiences for students and audiences alike.
As a performer, Roberts has had the opportunity to sing alongside internationally acclaimed artists Sarah Brightman and Danny Elfman through professional performance engagements. He has also performed with Nebraska Festival Singers and participated in numerous solo and choral performance opportunities. His musical interests span classical, contemporary, and musical theatre repertoire.
Roberts currently serves as a Show Choir Director at Papillion-La Vista South High School and previously worked with the show choir program at Lewis Central High School. Additionally, he is the owner and vocal instructor of Roberts Voice Studio, where he provides individualized vocal instruction focused on technique, musicianship, and confidence.
Following graduation, Roberts plans to continue his career in music education, sharing his passion for music with the next generation of musicians. Source: UNO School of Music

item.title: Student Recital - Andrew Milburn — Nov 14, 2026
item.description:
Strauss Performing Arts Center Saturday, November 14, 2026 · 6:30 PM On Saturday, November 14, at 6:30 Andrew Milburn will perform a senior voice recital at the Strauss Performing Arts Center’s Recital Hall on the University of Nebraska at Omaha’s campus. Andrew will perform a variety of classical works. Marissa Mathia will appear as collaborative pianist.
Andrew Milburn (voice) is a student of Dr. Jennifer Townsley. Andrew’s previous collegiate instructors included Alisa Belflower, Dalan Guthrie, and Alexandria Plumb. In his junior year, Andrew was awarded the Ruetz Scholarship for voice at the UNO School of Music. During his time in Omaha, he has performed throughout the greater Omaha area as part of the Opera Omaha chorus, an Alumni performer for Omaha Performing Arts, and leading roles in the UNO Opera such as The Miller and Don Alfonso. Andrew most recently appeared with the UNO Concert Choir as a member and section leader in their Fall concert. Looking forward, Andrew hopes to pursue a Master’s degree. Source: UNO School of Music
